title: AFP says it was the target of a cyberattack; AFP Forum platform isolated and temporarily inaccessible
geo_basis: AFP's dateline is Paris; the page does not name a headquarters city
summary: AFP said in an internal management message, as relayed by the agency, that it was the target of a cyberattack overnight from Wednesday to Thursday, starting at 01:30 Paris time. Its teams isolated the AFP Forum platform on detecting the intrusion, and it remains temporarily inaccessible as a precaution. AFP says it has no information on who carried out the attack.
plain: The news agency AFP says it was hit by a cyberattack overnight and cut off its AFP Forum platform as a precaution. It says it does not know who is behind it.
exec: A major news agency took a client content platform offline after an intrusion; AFP says it offered alternative solutions to clients.

evidence.quote: La AFP fue blanco de un ciberataque esta noche [del miércoles a jueves], a partir de la 01H30 [hora de París].

validation.note: Only one page was read (Unitel, relaying AFP's own message); a search found no second 2026 report, only coverage of AFP's 2024 incident.

review.note: compared date, 01:30 Paris time (00:30Z), internal management message, no-actor statement, alternative solutions with Unitel/AFP wire
